name: 45133 · Hillsboro, OH
findings: ZIP 45133 (Hillsboro) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45133 (Hillsboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45133 (Hillsboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
